name: Pie Register – User Registration, Profiles & Content Restriction
author: Shamim Rajani

sections.description:
Pie Register is a User Registration plugin to help you create custom Login and Registration forms in minutes, with no coding skills required. You can customize the registration process and build advance registration flows using the various form fields. The plugin also comes with some additional security features to keep your website spam-free.

Restrict content for exclusive Membership-based websites based on different user roles with Pie Register’s visibility restriction feature. You can create dynamic forms by giving your forms a personalized touch with Conditional Logic. Pie Register accepts payments using multiple payment gateways and restricts user registration based on invitations.

Pie Register has extensive documentation and video tutorials to help you get started. It has an active support system that responds to your queries within 24 hours.

The Best Part
Pie Register offers perpetual licensing – purchase once and use for a lifetime!

FREE KEY FEATURES

  • Drag and Drop Form Builder
  • Front-end User Profiles
  • Front-end User Registration
  • Front-end user Login
  • PasswordLess Registration
  • Advanced Fields
  • Set Redirection after Sign-up and Login
  • Verify and Moderate User Registration
  • Spam Protection
  • PayPal Standard – Payment Gateway
  • User Emails Templates and Automation
  • Invite-Based Registration
  • Auto-generate Password
  • Content Restriction
  • Data Import/Export
  • Custom User Roles
  • Profile Picture
  • ReCaptcha
  • Admin Helper Application
  • Shortcodes
  • Community Support
  • Developer friendly with dozens of actions and filters

KEY FEATURES AVAILABLE IN FREE AND PRO VERSIONS WITH

BASIC AND ADVANCED OPTIONS ==

  • File Upload
  • Verify and Moderate User Registration
  • Spam Protection
  • Custom User Roles
  • Invite-based Registration for Exclusive Websites
  • User and Admin Email Notification Templates
  • Data Import/Export
  • Content Restriction
  • Frontend User Login and forgot password forms

PREMIUM KEY FEATURES

  • Unlimited Registration Forms
  • Advanced Fields
  • Role-based Redirection
  • Invite through emails
  • Multiple Payment Gateways
  • Customizable Login Security
  • Timed-form submission (Define time in seconds to lock-out the bots)
  • Auto-login after Registration
  • Custom User Roles
  • User and Admin Email Notification Templates and Automation
  • Data Import/Export
  • Global Content Restriction
  • Restrict Widgets
  • Allow and Block users
  • Limit Form Entries Per Device
  • hCaptcha

  • Conditional Logic
  • Ticket-based Support

Complete Feature List

Invitation-based Registration

  • Generate invitation codes
  • Auto Generate invitation codes
  • Invite Users through Email
  • Allow Users to Invite Other Users
  • Track user Invitations

Make Your Forms More Advanced With Our Premium Add-ons

  • PayPal Subscriptions (Payment Gateway) Add-on
    Allow users to make recurring payments and view subscription using the PayPal Subscriptions add-on.

  • Stripe Recurring (Payment Gateway) Add-on
    Allow users to make recurring payments and view active subscriptions using the Stripe recurring payment add-on.

  • Stripe One-Time (Payment Gateway) Add-on
    Process membership payments using Pie Register’s Stripe Add-on.

  • Authroize.net (Payment Gateway ) Add-on
    Use Authorize.net Add-on to collect membership payments on Pie Register.

  • Social Login Add-on
    Let users log in via their social handles, i-e, Facebook, Twitter, Google, LinkedIn, Yahoo, and WordPress accounts, to make the registration process quick and hassle-free.

  • MailChimp Add-on
    Export site users into MailChimp lists to send communication, sales, and marketing emails using the admin dashboard.

  • Twilio - Two-step Authentication (SMS) Add-on
    Want to have a super-secure site? No Problem. With Pie Register and TWILIO, you can verify registration via SMS/Text messages sent to their cell phones. The admin can get notified when new users register.

  • Profile Search Add-on
    Allow users to search/filter to display user data with the Profile Search tool. User information displayed in the filtered/search results can be limited based on the admin’s choice.

  • Geo Location Add-on
    It lets you collect user Geolocation data and provides information like country, city, zip code, latitude/longitude, and location map for registered users.

  • Bulk Email Add-on
    Send emails in bulk to all the registered users at once. Select the form name, and all the users registered through that form and send emails in one go!

  • Field visibility Add-on
    Allows you to show or hide specific fields on the front-end registration form or the user’s profile page.

  • WooCommerce Add-on
    Hide or display specific Pie Register fields on the WooCommerce checkout page. Also, you can add billing and shipping fields to your registration form. Replace the default WooCommerce login and registration forms with Pie Register login and registration forms, and send a free gift product upon registration.

  • bbPress Add-on
    Show the Pie Register fields on your bbPress User profile, and let your users edit the profile directly from bbPress.

  • For login form use: [pie_register_login]
  • For Registration form use: [pie_register_form]
  • For forgot password form use: [pie_register_forgot_password]
  • For profile page use: [pie_register_profile]

What’s Next?

Liked Pie Register? Do check out our other projects.

Once your registration system is in place, make sure the rest of your website stays in top shape with WP Site Checker.
Run comprehensive checks for performance, security, SEO, broken links, accessibility, SSL, page speed, and more — all from a single WordPress plugin.
Learn more: WP Site Checker

Pie Forms: Pie Forms is your custom Drag and Drop Form Builder with a user-friendly interface, built-in ready-to-use templates, and various Form Field options to Create Advanced Forms without a single line of code. Apart from simple registration, it lets you create all forms, including contact forms, surveys, job applications, appointments, etc.

PB addons for WPBakery: Build your website with premium quality Web and WooCommerce elements for WPBakery Page Builder.

External services

Pie Register connects to the following third-party services. Each one is used only when the related feature is enabled by the site administrator.

Google reCAPTCHA
Used to protect registration, login and forgot-password forms from bots when reCAPTCHA is selected as the captcha type. The reCAPTCHA script is loaded from google.com on pages that show a protected form, and when a form is submitted the captcha response and the visitor’s IP address are sent to Google to be verified.
Terms of Service – Privacy Policy

Cloudflare Turnstile
Used to protect forms from bots when Cloudflare Turnstile is selected as the captcha type. The Turnstile script is loaded from challenges.cloudflare.com on pages that show a protected form, and when a form is submitted the Turnstile response and the visitor’s IP address are sent to Cloudflare to be verified.
Terms of Service – Privacy Policy

PayPal
Used to accept registration payments when the PayPal payment gateway is enabled. The user is redirected to PayPal with the payment amount, the PayPal button ID and a reference to their account, and PayPal’s payment notification (IPN) is sent back to PayPal for verification.
User Agreement – Privacy Statement

Pie Register license server (store.genetech.co)
Used only when an administrator activates or deactivates a premium add-on license key. The license key, the license email, the add-on name and version and the site URL are sent to verify the license.
Privacy Policy

Pie Register mobile app (Firebase Cloud Messaging)
Used only if an administrator signs in to the Pie Register mobile app. When a new user registers, the new username is sent through Google Firebase Cloud Messaging as a push notification to the administrator’s device. Feedback written in the app is emailed to the Pie Register team.
Firebase Terms – Google Privacy Policy – Pie Register Privacy Policy
sections.faq:
Who should use Pie Register?

Pie Register is perfect for membership websites for independent consultants, freelancers, and businesses alike. If you want to create a custom registration form for your WordPress site, you need to use Pie Register.

Do I need coding skills to use Pie Register?

Absolutely not. You can create and manage forms without any coding knowledge. Simply drag and drop the fields onto the form to quickly create full-featured registration forms. Our easy-to-use features help you create complex registration forms within minutes.

How can I be protected from spammers?

Pie Register has built-in support for reCaptcha that prevents bots or spammers from getting registered. There are numerous other anti-spamming features in Pie Register that help keep your registration process secure and spam-free.

I don’t want my blog/website to be overcrowded? What to do?

You can use the Invitation Codes feature to block unwanted registrations.

How can I prevent fake email addresses from registering?

You can enable the Email Validation feature from the Pie Register Settings page to send an email with a unique verification link every time a user gets registered.

How can I embed the Login/Forgot Password/Registration forms on my Custom Page(s) or sidebar?

With the use of Shortcodes ([pie_register_login], [pie_register_forgot_password] & [pie_register_form]) and built-in widgets, Pie Register allows you to place your forms anywhere you want on the website.

How do I set up the Profile pages?

Pie-Register provides you with a shortcode ([pie_register_profile]) to display the front-end profile page, allowing your users to edit their profiles. Enjoy the liberty to insert the shortcode on any page or even on custom post types.

How do I embed Forgot password login into the theme or in custom pages?

You can embed Forgot password login into your theme and custom pages by inserting a simple shortcode ([pie_register_forgot_password]).

How to accept payments via Pie Register?

Pie Register allows you to accept payments via Paypal, Stripe (paid add-on), and Authorize.net (paid add-on) by simply adding a membership field to your forms and synchronizing the details of the payment gateway with it.

Can I send/receive email alerts using Pie Register?

Yes, the admin can receive email alerts on the registration of a new user or when a user updates his profile. They can also send email alerts to users when their account is ready or activated, for email verification, and more. Pie Register offers 15 default templates for user notifications.

How can I moderate registrations in Pie Register?

You can verify and moderate registrations by choosing a method for verification from the Security Tab under the Settings option. Pie Register gives you three options to select from:
Admin Approval
Verify Email Address
Admin Approval AND Verify Email Address (Premium)

Can we customize the custom login form?

You can change/remove the label field and add a placeholder text to your custom login form in Pie Register. It adds in the functionality of verifying registrations and lets you block users too.

What if I do not want to use the custom login form?

Verifications and block user functionality won’t work if you do not want to use the custom login form by Pie Register.

How to add styles to your Pie Register forms?

To make your forms more interactive, you can simply add custom CSS in the stylesheet of your current theme.

How to make registrations PasswordLess with Pie Register?

Remove the password field from your forms and send an automated email on registrations by adding the auto-generated password in the email body using the replacement key.

4.0.0.0

Released Date 12th November 2026

  • New: Brand-new drag and drop Form Builder that replaces the classic builder screen. Existing forms open in it automatically, with nothing to migrate.
  • New: Form Builder – Field list with search. Click a field to add it, or drag it to any position on the form.
  • New: Form Builder – Live canvas with Desktop and Mobile preview. Click any field, the form title or the submit button to edit its settings in the side panel.
  • New: Form Builder – Field settings for label, placeholder, description, required, validation rule and message, CSS class and “Show in profile”.
  • New: Form Builder – Visual conditional logic editor. Show or hide a field based on other answers, with rule groups (AND inside a group, OR between groups) and operators such as is / is not, empty / not empty, greater / less than, contains, starts / ends with and in range.
  • New: Form Builder – Multi-step forms. Add steps and page breaks; inserting a page break after a field moves all the fields below it to a new step. Each step’s Next and Previous buttons can be text or an image.
  • New: Form Builder – Duplicate, move up / down, move to another step and remove fields from the field toolbar. Press Delete to remove the selected field.
  • New: Form Builder – Undo for every change, including each label or setting edit (button or Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z), with a warning before leaving or reloading the page with unsaved changes.
  • New: Form Builder – Form settings (title, label alignment, user role, user verification including verification by conditional logic, success message or redirect) and submit button settings (text and optional Reset button) in the same screen.
  • New: Registration Analytics page (Pie Register > Analytics) with a conversion funnel for each form: Views > Started > Submitted > Registered > Activated.
  • New: Analytics – Daily trend chart of views and registrations for the last 7, 30 or 90 days, or a custom date range.
  • New: Analytics – Field drop-off report showing how many visitors used each field, where they abandoned the form and which fields caused validation errors. The field that loses the most visitors is highlighted.
  • New: Analytics – Traffic sources report built from UTM campaign tags (source, medium, campaign), with views, registrations and conversion rate for each.
  • New: Analytics – CSV export, and an “Analytics” link for each form on the Manage Forms screen (replaces the old Views / Submissions columns).
  • New: Analytics – Privacy-friendly by design: no IP address, user agent, user ID or field value is stored. Options to exclude logged-in users, respect Do-Not-Track / Global Privacy Control, require consent (WP Consent API supported), set data retention periods and delete all analytics data. Suggested text is added to the WordPress Privacy Policy guide.
  • New: Cloudflare Turnstile captcha. Select it under Settings > Security > reCAPTCHA Type, enter your Turnstile Site Key and Secret Key, and it protects the registration, login and forgot password forms.
  • New: Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible as a captcha type (uses the v2 key fields; create the keys as “Invisible reCAPTCHA badge”).
  • Update: Font Awesome upgraded from 4.7.0 to 6.7.2.
  • Update: The bundled CKEditor 4 (no longer maintained) is replaced by the editor built into WordPress (TinyMCE) for HTML fields and email messages.
  • Update: The jquery.Wload loading overlay is replaced by a lightweight built-in version with the same API.
  • Update: Removed the outdated jQuery mCustomScrollbar, jQuery Mousewheel, jQuery Confirm and php.js libraries. Admin panels now use native browser scrolling.
  • Update: Form field settings are now passed to the builder as JSON instead of PHP-serialized data.
  • Update: Added a shared hourly scheduled task (WP-Cron) for background jobs such as analytics summaries and cleanup.
  • Security: Improved sanitization of form builder data.

External services

Pie Register connects to the following third-party services. Each one is used only when the related feature is enabled by the site administrator.

Google reCAPTCHA
Used to protect registration, login and forgot-password forms from bots when reCAPTCHA is selected as the captcha type. The reCAPTCHA script is loaded from google.com on pages that show a protected form, and when a form is submitted the captcha response and the visitor’s IP address are sent to Google to be verified.
Terms of Service – Privacy Policy

Cloudflare Turnstile
Used to protect forms from bots when Cloudflare Turnstile is selected as the captcha type. The Turnstile script is loaded from challenges.cloudflare.com on pages that show a protected form, and when a form is submitted the Turnstile response and the visitor’s IP address are sent to Cloudflare to be verified.
Terms of Service – Privacy Policy

PayPal
Used to accept registration payments when the PayPal payment gateway is enabled. The user is redirected to PayPal with the payment amount, the PayPal button ID and a reference to their account, and PayPal’s payment notification (IPN) is sent back to PayPal for verification.
User Agreement – Privacy Statement

Pie Register license server (store.genetech.co)
Used only when an administrator activates or deactivates a premium add-on license key. The license key, the license email, the add-on name and version and the site URL are sent to verify the license.
Privacy Policy

Pie Register mobile app (Firebase Cloud Messaging)
Used only if an administrator signs in to the Pie Register mobile app. When a new user registers, the new username is sent through Google Firebase Cloud Messaging as a push notification to the administrator’s device. Feedback written in the app is emailed to the Pie Register team.
Firebase Terms – Google Privacy Policy – Pie Register Privacy Policy
